reactor_type: commercial flow-type ALD reactor (ASM Microchemistry Ltd.)
evidence: The films were deposited using four different deposition schemes presented in Table 1. The pulse lengths of TiCl4 (0.2 s) and NH3 (0.5 s) were the same as those used in the previous studies on TiN, and for TMA a pulse length of 0.5 s was chosen. The purge length used after each reactant pulse was 0.3 s, and the films were grown using 4000 deposition cycles. Deposition temperatures were varied between 250 and 400 C.
